open.title: Open a project
open.description: Reads the saved FieldWorks language project and reports its identity and key counts. Use it to confirm a project path before measuring it.
open.source: Hand-written from docs/cli-api.md and command behavior.

word-context.title: Read one word's context
word-context.description: Reads a word's captured FieldWorks presence and every stored analysis with its individual Opinion. Uses the current Baseline without requiring a Selection or an Assessment, and reports whether FieldWorks has saved since.
word-context.source: Hand-written from the shared WordContext query.

analyses.title: Inspect word analyses
analyses.description: Lists manually approved analyses, or adds parser results from a named Assessment when current digests are supplied. It does not run PanGloss.
analyses.source: Hand-written from docs/cli-api.md and command behavior.

config show.title: Show project settings
config show.description: Reads the project's Assessment scopes and settings. Use it to see the limits and options Motif will use for a later Assessment.
config show.source: Hand-written from docs/cli-api.md and command behavior.

store upgrade.title: Upgrade project store
store upgrade.description: Carries authored work into the current store and keeps a backup of the old store. Computed results are discarded and can be recreated.
store upgrade.source: Hand-written from the project store upgrade behavior.

store prune.title: Prune project store
store prune.description: Removes older standalone Assessments that are no longer needed by retained evidence. It also reclaims available space in the project store.
store prune.source: Hand-written from the project store retention behavior.

project initialize.title: Prepare a project for Motif
project initialize.description: Creates Motif's reserved human judgment field in a FieldWorks project after explicit confirmation. It does not add a judgment or create a writing system.
project initialize.source: Hand-written from the project initialization contract and command behavior.

project tag.title: Read a project tag
project tag.description: Reads the tag Motif stores for this project on this machine. When its vernacular language code is already used, Motif tries the exact folder name and refuses if that choice is invalid or taken.
project tag.source: Hand-written from the machine-local project-tag behavior.

project tag --set.title: Set a project tag
project tag --set.description: Chooses the tag Motif stores for this project on this machine. The tag must follow the lowercase rules and be unused by every other Known project.
project tag --set.source: Hand-written from the machine-local project-tag behavior.

report.title: Read an Assessment report
report.description: Calculates a named report from an Assessment and project data. Use it to answer a focused question about words, Texts, or grammar without rerunning PanGloss.
report.source: Hand-written from docs/cli-api.md and command behavior.

report --list-kinds.title: List report kinds
report --list-kinds.description: Lists the report kinds accepted by report --kind. Run it first when you need to choose a report for stored evidence.
report --list-kinds.source: Hand-written from docs/cli-api.md and command behavior.

parsimony.title: Review grammar parsimony
parsimony.description: Runs a registered Parsimony measure, or every measure with --measure all, over the current Baseline, or compares a completed Proposal Dry Run against that Baseline. Candidate evidence uses a private copy and stores before and after Reports. Use parsimony measures to list checks and their evidence needs.

parsimony --wait.title: Wait for a Parsimony Report
parsimony --wait.description: Queues the requested Parsimony measure and waits for its stored Report. It does not capture a Baseline or require an Assessment.

parsimony --measure all --wait.title: Run every Parsimony measure
parsimony --measure all --wait.description: Runs every Parsimony measure this build supports in one job over one verified evidence bundle, then waits and returns one stored Report per measure. It does not capture a Baseline or require an Assessment.

parsimony latest.title: Find the newest Report
parsimony latest.description: Names the newest stored Parsimony Report and the bundle it was measured from. It reads the project's store only and does not run PanGloss.

parsimony show.title: Read a Parsimony Report
parsimony show.description: Reads a stored Parsimony Report by id. It uses the saved Report and does not run PanGloss.

parsimony retirement-review.title: Read a retirement review
parsimony retirement-review.description: Reads the review state for one staged rule-based allomorph retirement Draft. It returns its latest matching Dry Run and names evidence that is not available yet; it never invents a finding or parser result.

parsimony measures.title: List Parsimony measures
parsimony measures.description: Lists registered grammar checks, their axes, evidence tiers, citations, and fixed views. It reads the catalog without invoking PanGloss.

parsimony expectations.title: Read Parsimony expectations
parsimony expectations.description: Reads human-confirmed negatives and native Approved and Disapproved readings from the saved FieldWorks project. The versioned projection keeps surface negatives, exact reading negatives, and native Opinions separate for later Parsimony measures and paired verification.
parsimony expectations.source: Hand-written from the expectation projection contract.

parsimony view.title: Read a Parsimony view
parsimony view.description: Reads a bounded page from a fixed view over one frozen bundle. Parser views use a Report id to bind the exact Assessment references; filters and cursors are bound to the bundle. Only the declared view filters are accepted.

parsimony record-types.title: List Notebook record types
parsimony record-types.description: Lists the saved Notebook record types with their portable IDs and readable names. Use the ID when you stage a Parsimony disposition.

parsimony dispose.title: Stage a finding disposition
parsimony dispose.description: Stages a keep, fix, ask, or defer decision from one finding in a stored Parsimony Report. It derives the exact subject and evidence from that finding and appends the existing Notebook operations to a Draft Proposal. Only a person can Apply.

parsimony revise.title: Revise a disposition
parsimony revise.description: Stages a revision to a saved Parsimony disposition using its exact current Notebook heads and digests. The revision keeps the same finding subject and evidence, and only a person can Apply it.

parsimony retract.title: Retract a disposition
parsimony retract.description: Stages a withdrawal of a saved Parsimony disposition using its exact current Notebook heads and digests. The history stays in FieldWorks, and the finding returns to Active after a person Applies the current retraction.

parsimony negative confirm.title: Confirm a reviewed negative
parsimony negative confirm.description: Confirms a forbidden surface form or exact reading as a human and stages its Notebook record in a Draft Proposal. A negative may have no grammar owner; only Apply writes it to the FieldWorks project.
parsimony negative confirm.source: Hand-written from the reviewed-negative authoring contract.

parsimony negative retract.title: Retract a reviewed negative
parsimony negative retract.description: Withdraws a reviewed negative by naming its exact current revision heads and stages a retraction in a Draft Proposal. The Notebook history remains in the FieldWorks project, and only Apply records the withdrawal.
parsimony negative retract.source: Hand-written from the reviewed-negative authoring contract.

compose-record-parsimony-disposition.title: Stage a Parsimony disposition
compose-record-parsimony-disposition.description: Stages a keep, fix, ask, or defer decision for one exact Parsimony finding in a Draft Proposal. A pending keep does not suppress current findings, and only a person can Apply it.

fields.recordTypeId: Id of an existing possibility in the Notebook record type list.
fields.subject: The exact finding subject: kind, plus the fields that kind needs. An edge role is membership, precedence, rhs, left-context, right-context or constraint-use; a computed-group role is alternation-family, duplicate-pair, adhoc-cluster or adhoc-slot-order.
fields.disposition: The proposed decision: fix, keep, ask or defer.
fields.evidenceDigest: Canonical sha256 digest from the exact finding.
fields.evidenceContract: Versioned evidence contract for the finding.
fields.subjectCaption: Readable name for the exact finding subject.
fields.measureCaption: Readable name for the Parsimony measure.
fields.reason: Optional explanation, stored with the readable record.
fields.question: Required only when disposition is ask.

goals: Keep a finding as it is
Decide to fix a finding later
Record a question about a finding

retire-allomorph.title: Retire or merge forms
retire-allomorph.description: Stages one connected Proposal to retire ordinary prefix or suffix alternates after their references move; the sound-rule form also stages its natural class and rule. Dry Run shows bundle Morph and copied Form text changes, other references, and deletion together. Missing destinations are refused with counts for distinct unresolved Approved analyses, ad hoc rules, and other references; only a person can Apply.
retire-allomorph.source: Hand-written from the allomorph retirement and sound-rule replacement contracts.

fields.format: motif-retire-allomorph for a duplicate-form retirement, or motif-allomorph-retirement for a sound-rule replacement.
fields.retirement: Duplicate-form retirement only: the entry, its scope, the forms to retire and every bundle, role and ad hoc reference that moves.
fields.duplicateSurvivors: Duplicate-form retirement only: the exact surviving forms, each with its identity and semantic digest.
fields.naturalClass: Rule replacement only: the sound class to create or reuse.
fields.rule: Rule replacement only: the rewrite rule that replaces the listed forms, with its context and placement.
fields.retirements: Rule replacement only: one retirement for each entry, in the same shape as retirement.
fields.operations: Rule replacement only: the binding of every class, rule, retarget and deletion operation to its slot and dependencies.
fields.display: Rule replacement only: optional review title and description, left out of the retirement digest.

goals: Retire an allomorph and move its references to another allomorph
Merge redundant allomorphs of an affix into one
Replace a duplicate form with the form a phonological rule derives
Retire an unused prefix or suffix alternate after moving what refers to it
retire-allomorph.redirect: Retires listed forms and moves their references. Retire only a redundant form, and check every affected approved word in a Trial (guide no-inflection).

retire-redundant-zero-affix.title: Retire an unused zero affix
retire-redundant-zero-affix.description: Stages deletion of one whole, unreferenced zero-affix entry when its only loaded realization is a recognized null marker, it adds no feature or class, every assigned slot is optional, and no assigned slot occurs in a template. Optional slot links are removed first and the slots remain; meaningful, referenced, or parser-distinguishing zeros are refused. Only a person can Apply.
retire-redundant-zero-affix.source: Hand-written from the zero-affix retirement contract and command behavior.

fields.retirement: The one zero-affix entry to retire, as an object with entry, its canonical id.

goals: Delete a zero affix nobody uses
Remove an unused null affix entry from the lexicon
Retire a redundant zero morpheme that adds no feature
Clean up an empty affix whose slots are all optional
retire-redundant-zero-affix.redirect: Removes a zero affix that adds no feature. Keep one the evidence shows is a real position, and check affected words in a Trial (guide no-inflection).

compose-author-phonological-rule.title: Author a phonological rule
compose-author-phonological-rule.description: Stages one simple rewrite rule in a Draft, using existing phonemes and natural classes with explicit context and rule placement. Empty input or output means insertion or deletion; unsupported alpha variables and metathesis are refused. Only a person can Apply.
compose-author-phonological-rule.source: Hand-written from the regular rewrite-rule composer contract and command behavior.
goals: Add a vowel harmony rule
Make a consonant assimilate in voicing or place to a neighbouring sound
Delete a segment or insert one in a given context
Devoice, nasalise or palatalise a word-final or intervocalic sound
compose-author-phonological-rule.redirect: Use for a regular sound change across many forms. Not for one irregular word: use an alternate form or allomorph (guide conditioned-allomorphs).

compose-author-lexical-entry.title: Author a lexical entry
compose-author-lexical-entry.description: Stages one new dictionary entry with its lexeme form, one sense with gloss and optional definition, and grammatical info: a stem, or an inflectional, derivational or unclassified affix. An inflectional affix can name the inflection classes its form attaches to; use compose-edit-derivational-affix-restriction for a derivational affix. Inspect its Dry Run and try words with it before a person Applies the Proposal.
goals: Add a new word to the dictionary with its meaning
Enter a root or stem in the lexicon with a gloss and category
Add a prefix or suffix entry with a short gloss
Create a lexical entry with a citation form and part of speech
compose-author-lexical-entry.redirect: For an affix, prefer an inflectional or derivational MSA with categories and a slot over unclassified (guide suffix-prefix-slots). One entry per morpheme, not per stem.

compose-author-affix-process-allomorph.title: Add an affix process allomorph
compose-author-affix-process-allomorph.description: Stages one more pattern-based form, an affix process with its own input pattern and output, on an existing affix entry that already realizes itself as a process. The entry's morph type is copied and the form applies to all of the entry's grammatical info. It refuses a stem, an entry with plain allomorphs, a repeated pattern and a missing placement.
compose-author-affix-process-allomorph.source: Authored from the typed command contract.

fields.entry: Id of the existing or earlier-staged affix entry whose lexeme form is an affix process.
fields.input: Ordered pattern parts, each with a name and one of phoneme, naturalClass or remaining true; the remaining-stem part is last.
fields.output: Ordered realization, each item either copy of a named input part or insert of phoneme ids. An input part left out of the output is deleted.
fields.inflectionClasses: Optional ids of inflection classes of the stems this form attaches to. Inflectional affixes only; a derivational affix is refused (use compose-edit-derivational-affix-restriction).
fields.placement: The neighbouring alternate form ids, after, before or both; required when the entry already has alternate forms.

goals: Give one affix a second pattern-based form for other stems
Add a nasal substitution form to an affix that already has one
Add a form to an affix that already uses an affix process
compose-author-affix-process-allomorph.redirect: Use for one morpheme with several pattern-based forms. Plain spelling variants use an alternate form; a new morpheme needs its own entry (guide conditioned-allomorphs).

compose-author-alternate-form.title: Author an alternate form
compose-author-alternate-form.description: Stages one more stem or affix form on an existing or earlier-staged entry, with its own environments and, when the entry has inflectional grammatical info, inflection classes. Use compose-edit-derivational-affix-restriction for a derivational analysis. It adds no entry, sense or grammatical info and copies no condition from the lexeme form.
goals: Give a prefix a second form before vowels
Add a stem variant that appears in one environment
Record another shape of an existing affix
compose-author-alternate-form.redirect: Use for a listed variant of one morpheme. Not for a regular sound change, a phonological rule (guide nasal-assimilation), or a pattern-based form (compose-author-affix-process-allomorph).

compose-author-part-of-speech.title: Author a part of speech
compose-author-part-of-speech.description: Stages a new part of speech, at the top of the category list or under an existing category, with its name and optional abbreviation. Later composer calls in the same Draft can use it as the category of entries, slots and affixes.
goals: Add a category for verbs the project lacks
Create a subcategory such as transitive verb
Add a noun category with an abbreviation
compose-author-part-of-speech.redirect: Add a category only when the evidence needs one; slots and classes belong to a category, so author it before them (guide suffix-prefix-slots).

compose-author-affix-slot.title: Author an affix slot
compose-author-affix-slot.description: Stages a named inflectional affix slot owned by an existing category and can assign existing inflectional affixes to it in the same Draft. Inspect its Dry Run and Trial before a person Applies the Proposal.
goals: Add a slot for a plural suffix that attaches to nouns
Make a slot for a subject prefix on verbs
Put existing inflectional affixes into a new slot
compose-author-affix-slot.redirect: Put affixes in slots in speakers' order. No entry per stem, and no one broad slot for affixes with different jobs (guide suffix-prefix-slots).

compose-author-affix-template.title: Author an affix template
compose-author-affix-template.description: Stages an active alternative template on an existing category, using ordered prefix and suffix slots that belong to the category or an ancestor. It preserves existing template order and records whether this template requires further derivation. Only a person can Apply.
goals: Arrange the prefix and suffix slots of a verb
Build a template for the order of noun affixes
Add an alternative template for a category
compose-author-affix-template.redirect: Put affixes in slots in speakers' order. No entry per stem, and no one broad slot for affixes with different jobs (guide suffix-prefix-slots).

compare.title: Compare two Assessments
compare.description: Joins two stored Assessments on their shared words and stores the Difference as a new Assessment. It lets you inspect changes without treating the result as a verdict.
compare.source: Hand-written from docs/cli-api.md and command behavior.

baseline capture.title: Capture a Baseline
baseline capture.description: Reads the saved .fwdata project to create or reuse a file-backed Baseline. Use it when the latest FieldWorks save should be the point of comparison for later work.
baseline capture.source: Hand-written from docs/cli-api.md and command behavior.

assess.title: Measure a Selection
assess.description: Runs PanGloss over chosen Texts or word forms and stores the resulting Assessments. After FieldWorks saves project changes, capture a new Baseline before measuring them.
assess.source: Hand-written from docs/cli-api.md and command behavior.

stats.title: Query parse statistics
stats.description: Forwards statistics options to PanGloss using the grammar and cache recorded for an Assessment. Use it to inspect parser work after an Assessment is available.
stats.source: Hand-written from docs/cli-api.md and command behavior.

selection show.title: Show the Default Selection
selection show.description: Reads the saved Texts, added words, and limits that determine what an Assessment measures when no other Selection is supplied.
selection show.source: Hand-written from docs/cli-api.md and command behavior.

selection set-default.title: Choose a Default Selection
selection set-default.description: Saves which project Texts and words Motif should measure by default. Use it to focus repeated Assessments on material a linguist has chosen.
selection set-default.source: Hand-written from docs/cli-api.md and command behavior.

selection set-limits.title: Set Selection limits
selection set-limits.description: Changes only the saved Default Selection's parsing limits when its expected revision still matches. Use it to update the step cap or estimated-versus-explicit time policy without replacing the chosen Texts and added words.
selection set-limits.source: Hand-written from docs/cli-api.md and command behavior.

setup skip.title: Skip project setup
setup skip.description: Marks first-time Selection setup as skipped for this project. Use it when the project can be opened but a Default Selection should not be chosen yet.
setup skip.source: Hand-written from docs/cli-api.md and command behavior.

texts list.title: List project Texts
texts list.description: Lists Text records from the project's current Baseline with their identity and interlinearization data. Use it to find Text ids for a Default Selection or Assessment.
texts list.source: Hand-written from docs/cli-api.md and command behavior.

overview.title: Read the project Overview
overview.description: Displays the latest saved counts, Text Coverage, manual-analysis agreement, timing, and warnings. It reads stored evidence and does not start a new run.
overview.source: Hand-written from docs/cli-api.md and command behavior.

warnings.title: Read grammar warnings
warnings.description: Reads stored grammar findings and allomorph refusals from parsing, with filters by code or warning level. Confirmed uses of Selection words stay separate from spelling and membership matches.
warnings.source: Hand-written from docs/cli-api.md and command behavior.

grammar check.title: Check a grammar
grammar check.description: Runs the grammar checker against the project's current Baseline and stores its findings. Use warnings to read those findings afterward. The stored-analysis comparison follows the Default proposal checks setting unless the command overrides it.
grammar check.source: Hand-written from docs/cli-api.md and command behavior.

timing.title: Inspect parse timing
timing.description: Reads timing evidence for an Assessment, optionally narrowed to words or grouped by kind or rule. Use it to locate expensive parsing work after an Assessment.
timing.source: Hand-written from docs/cli-api.md and command behavior.

activity.title: Summarize agent activity
activity.description: Reads an activity log written by motif mcp --activity-log and reports calls by tool, errors, refusals by code, and how often the agent followed the advice it was given. Nothing is sent anywhere.
activity.source: Authored from the agent activity log contract.

handoff.title: Prepare an AI Handoff
handoff.description: Writes a folder with the grammar and selected Texts, plus retained parse evidence when an invocation is selected. The files contain real project data, so review them before sharing.
handoff.source: Hand-written from docs/cli-api.md and command behavior.

trace.title: Trace a word
trace.description: Runs PanGloss for one word against the project's current Baseline and returns its diagnostic. Use it to inspect recorded analyses and trace events.

trace --load.title: Load a saved trace
trace --load.description: Reads a saved diagnostic without opening a project or starting PanGloss. Use it to inspect earlier trace evidence with the same reader as a live trace.

add-corpus.title: Describe a Corpus
add-corpus.description: Creates an empty Corpus and records its provenance, tokenisation, and licence capabilities. Use it before adding Documents to the Corpus.
add-corpus.source: Hand-written from docs/cli-api.md and command behavior.

add-document.title: Add a Corpus Document
add-document.description: Reads one source file or URL into a named Corpus Document and records its origin and licence details. Use it to preserve where an individual Document came from.
add-document.source: Hand-written from docs/cli-api.md and command behavior.

add-corpus-bundle.title: Load a Corpus bundle
add-corpus-bundle.description: Reads a bundle from a fetching tool and loads each listed source as a Document in its Corpus. The Motif store keeps the fetched text with its provenance and licence details.
add-corpus-bundle.source: Hand-written from docs/cli-api.md and command behavior.

corpora.title: List Corpora
corpora.description: Lists the Corpora and their recorded provenance. Use it to find a Corpus id before adding or inspecting a Document.
corpora.source: Hand-written from docs/cli-api.md and command behavior.

show-corpus.title: Show a Corpus
show-corpus.description: Reads the provenance, tokeniser, and licence capabilities recorded for one Corpus. Use it to verify what a Corpus allows before using its text as evidence.
show-corpus.source: Hand-written from docs/cli-api.md and command behavior.

baseline-refresh.title: Queue a Baseline Refresh
baseline-refresh.description: Queues a job to capture the project's saved state as a Baseline. Use it when you want to monitor the capture through the job queue.
baseline-refresh.source: Hand-written from docs/cli-api.md and command behavior.

jobs wait.title: Wait for a job
jobs wait.description: Waits for a job to reach a terminal state and reports its result. A parsing time limit returns exit code 5 with word counts.

jobs show.title: Inspect a job
jobs show.description: Reads the stored status of one durable job. Use it to inspect a Baseline Refresh, Dry Run, Trial, or Parsimony job's current lifecycle state.
jobs show.source: Hand-written from docs/cli-api.md and command behavior.

jobs assessments.title: Read job Assessments
jobs assessments.description: Lists the Assessments produced by one completed job. Use it after jobs show reports completion and you need the evidence ids.
jobs assessments.source: Hand-written from docs/cli-api.md and command behavior.

jobs list.title: List queued jobs
jobs list.description: Lists jobs across Known projects in queue order. Use it to see which work will run next or find a job id for inspection.
jobs list.source: Hand-written from docs/cli-api.md and command behavior.

jobs cancel.title: Cancel a job
jobs cancel.description: Requests cancellation of a queued or running job. Use it when the work is no longer needed, then inspect the final state with jobs show.
jobs cancel.source: Hand-written from docs/cli-api.md and command behavior.

jobs requeue.title: Retry a job
jobs requeue.description: Queues an eligible job to run again. Use it after inspecting a refusal or transient failure; requeue does not change Proposal content.
jobs requeue.source: Hand-written from docs/cli-api.md and command behavior.

jobs move.title: Reorder queued work
jobs move.description: Changes a job's position in the queue by moving it before another job or to either end. Use it when work across Known projects needs a different order.
jobs move.source: Hand-written from docs/cli-api.md and command behavior.

apply.title: Apply with Readiness override
apply.description: Applies one Proposal using its already bound Dry Run. The optional --force option skips Readiness checks only; changes that no longer fit remain refused. MCP never applies; the CLI applies in person or in Autonomous mode, which refuses --force.

apply --all-pending.title: Apply pending changes
apply --all-pending.description: Applies the current pending changes to the FieldWorks project as one unit of work. A current Dry Run can waive Correctness for a judgment-only Proposal; mixed changes still need normal Readiness evidence.
apply --all-pending.source: Hand-written from docs/cli-api.md and command behavior.

writing-systems.title: Show writing systems
writing-systems.description: Reads fonts, features, direction and style sizes from the current Baseline, in FieldWorks writing-system order. Change these settings in FieldWorks, then capture a new Baseline to read them here.
writing-systems.source: Hand-written from the shared writing-systems query.

compose-edit-adhoc-prohibition.title: Edit an ad hoc prohibition
compose-edit-adhoc-prohibition.description: Stages one explicit Disabled value for a flat allomorph or morpheme prohibition in a Draft. The expected value guards against stale evidence; Motif never Applies this change automatically. Only a person can Apply.
goals: Turn off a rule that forbids two forms together
Switch a prohibition back on
Disable a duplicated prohibition
compose-edit-adhoc-prohibition.redirect: Only disables or enables an existing prohibition. Prefer a slot, template, feature or environment that removes the need (guides suffix-prefix-slots, feature-conditioned-slots).

compose-edit-compound-rule.title: Turn a compound rule off or on
compose-edit-compound-rule.description: Stages one explicit Disabled value for an endocentric or exocentric compound rule in a Draft. FieldWorks compound rules join any two stems, so a rule that builds non-words can be switched off; the expected value guards against stale evidence, and only a person can Apply.
compose-edit-compound-rule.source: Hand-written from the closed intent and composer contract.

fields.target: Id of the compound rule to turn off or on.
fields.expectedDisabled: Whether the rule is turned off now: true when it is, false when it is on.
fields.disabled: Whether the rule should be turned off: true to turn it off, false to turn it on.

goals: Stop compounding from making non-words
Disable a compound rule that accepts any two stems
Switch a compound rule back on
compose-edit-compound-rule.redirect: Only turns existing compounding off or on; it builds and fixes nothing. Trial known compounds before and after, and ask the linguist first (guide workflow).

compose-set-entry-do-not-parse.title: Set entry parsing flag
compose-set-entry-do-not-parse.description: Stages the FieldWorks do-not-parse flag on a lexical entry. PanGloss excludes the entire entry from parsing, not just compounds. The FieldWorks HermitCrab loader currently ignores this flag.
compose-set-entry-do-not-parse.source: Hand-written from the FieldWorks model and parser importer.

fields.expectedDoNotParse: The flag value currently stored on the entry.
fields.doNotParse: The flag value to store: true to mark the entry do-not-parse, false to clear it.

goals: Mark a lexical entry do not parse
Clear a lexical entry do-not-parse flag
compose-set-entry-do-not-parse.redirect: Whole-entry exclusion, not compound-only. PanGloss honors it; FieldWorks HermitCrab currently ignores it. Ask the linguist before staging.

compose-set-no-default-compounding.title: Set default compounding
compose-set-no-default-compounding.description: Stages one explicit change to the parser's built-in default compounding in a Draft. A project with no compound rules of its own still has the parser join any two stems unless default compounding is turned off; the expected value guards against stale evidence, and only a person can Apply.
compose-set-no-default-compounding.source: Hand-written from the closed intent and composer contract.

fields.expectedNoDefaultCompounding: Whether default compounding is turned off now: true when it is, false when it is on.
fields.noDefaultCompounding: Whether default compounding should be turned off: true to turn it off, false to turn it on.

goals: Stop default compounding from accepting non-words
Turn off the parser's built-in compounding when the language has no compound rules
Switch default compounding back on
compose-set-no-default-compounding.redirect: Only turns the parser's built-in default compounding off or on; it authors no compound rule. Trial known compounds first and ask the linguist (guide workflow).

compose-edit-affix-slot.title: Edit an affix slot
compose-edit-affix-slot.description: Changes whether an existing inflectional affix slot is optional. The response lists every affix and template using the shared slot; Motif stages a Draft and never Applies it automatically. Only a person can Apply.
goals: Make an affix slot optional
Make a slot required again
See which affixes and templates a slot affects
compose-edit-affix-slot.redirect: Put affixes in slots in speakers' order. No entry per stem, and no one broad slot for affixes with different jobs (guide suffix-prefix-slots).

compose-edit-affix-template.title: Edit an affix template
compose-edit-affix-template.description: Adds, removes or reorders the existing prefix or suffix slots of a known affix template. Motif stages a Draft without Applying it automatically. Only a person can Apply.
goals: Add a slot to a template
Reorder the suffix slots
Remove a slot from a template
compose-edit-affix-template.redirect: Put affixes in slots in speakers' order. No entry per stem, and no one broad slot for affixes with different jobs (guide suffix-prefix-slots).

compose-edit-inflectional-affix.title: Edit an inflectional affix
compose-edit-inflectional-affix.description: Changes which existing category slots an inflectional affix MSA uses. Other MSA kinds and slots outside the category hierarchy are refused; Motif stages a Draft and never Applies it automatically. Only a person can Apply.
goals: Move an affix into a different slot
Change which slots an inflectional affix can fill
compose-edit-inflectional-affix.redirect: Put affixes in slots in speakers' order. No entry per stem, and no one broad slot for affixes with different jobs (guide suffix-prefix-slots).

compose-edit-part-of-speech-inflection-c.title: Set a category class default
compose-edit-part-of-speech-inflection-c.description: Sets or clears a part of speech's explicit default inflection class after checking the expected current reference. Clearing can reveal an inherited default; Motif stages a Draft for a person to review and Apply.
compose-edit-part-of-speech-inflection-c.source: Hand-written from the closed intent and composer contract.

fields.target: Id of the part of speech whose explicit default inflection class changes.
fields.expectedInflectionClass: Id of the explicit default class stored now, or null when it has none; an inherited default does not count.
fields.inflectionClass: Id of the class to make the explicit default, or null to clear it.

goals: Set the default class for nouns
Clear a category's default inflection class
compose-edit-part-of-speech-inflection-c.redirect: Sets only the default class for a category's stems. Use it when most stems share a class, not to cover exceptions (guide feature-conditioned-slots).

compose-edit-stem-allomorph-stem-name.title: Set a stem allomorph's name
compose-edit-stem-allomorph-stem-name.description: Sets or clears the stem name of one stem allomorph after checking the expected current stem name. The name must belong to a stem category of the entry or an ancestor; Motif stages a Draft for a person to review and Apply.
compose-edit-stem-allomorph-stem-name.source: Hand-written from the closed intent and composer contract.

fields.target: Id of the stem allomorph, the lexeme form or an alternate form, to edit.
fields.expectedStemName: Id of the stem name the allomorph has now, or null when it has none.
fields.stemName: Id of the stem name to set, or null to clear it.

goals: Say which stem name a stem variant uses
Clear the stem name from a variant
compose-edit-stem-allomorph-stem-name.redirect: Keep variants of one morpheme under one entry with narrow conditions. Not for a regular sound change across forms: use a phonological rule (guide nasal-assimilation).

compose-edit-stem-inflection-class.title: Set a stem's class
compose-edit-stem-inflection-class.description: Sets or clears the inflection class of one stem analysis after checking the expected current class. The class must belong to the stem's part of speech or an ancestor; Motif stages a Draft for a person to review and Apply.
compose-edit-stem-inflection-class.source: Hand-written from the closed intent and composer contract.

fields.target: Id of the stem analysis whose inflection class changes.
fields.expectedInflectionClass: Id of the class the stem analysis has now, or null when it has none.
fields.inflectionClass: Id of the class to set, or null to clear it.

goals: Assign a stem to its noun class
Change the inflection class of one stem
Clear a stem's class
compose-edit-stem-inflection-class.redirect: Restrict a slot's affix by feature value; do not copy affixes or slots per value. Arbitrary lexical grouping is an inflection class (guide feature-conditioned-slots).

compose-link-variant.title: Link a variant
compose-link-variant.description: Links a variant reference to its main entry or sense and sets its variant type. Self-links and cycles are refused; Motif stages a Draft for a person to review and Apply.
compose-link-variant.source: Hand-written from the closed intent and composer contract.

fields.target: Id of the existing variant reference.
fields.component: Id of the main entry or sense.
fields.variantType: Id of a type in the project's variant types list.

goals: Link a variant to its main entry
Replace a variant's target or type

compose-delete-empty-sense.title: Delete an empty sense
compose-delete-empty-sense.description: Deletes an empty sense and its unused analysis. An analysis containing only a part of speech is allowed when the entry has a linked variant reference; Motif stages a Draft for a person to review and Apply.
compose-delete-empty-sense.source: Hand-written from the closed intent and composer contract.

fields.target: Id of the empty sense to delete.
fields.entry: Id of the entry that owns the sense; a different owner is refused.

goals: Remove an empty sense from a variant entry
Delete a sense and its unused analysis
Clean up blank senses left by an import

compose-rewrite-lexeme-form.title: Rewrite lexeme forms
compose-rewrite-lexeme-form.description: Rewrites the lexeme form of many existing entries in one Draft, each guarded by the form it must hold now, and can keep the old spelling as the citation form. Use it when the lexeme form carries stress marks the parser cannot match; Motif stages a Draft and never Applies it automatically. Only a person can Apply.
compose-rewrite-lexeme-form.source: Hand-written from the closed intent and composer contract.

fields.entries: The entries to rewrite, each with entryGuid, writingSystem, expectedForm and newForm; a current form that differs from expectedForm refuses the whole batch.
fields.setEmptyCitationForm: When true, an entry with no citation form in that writing system gets its old lexeme form as the citation form.
fields.foldStressMarks: When true, omit newForm: it is computed from expectedForm by removing U+0300, U+0301, U+0302, U+0304 and U+030C only.

goals: Remove stress marks from lexeme forms so the parser matches them
Rewrite the lexeme form of many entries at once
Keep the stress-marked spelling as the citation form
compose-rewrite-lexeme-form.redirect: Keep variants of one morpheme under one entry with narrow conditions. Not for a regular sound change across forms: use a phonological rule (guide nasal-assimilation).

compose-set-stem-part-of-speech.title: Set a stem's part of speech
compose-set-stem-part-of-speech.description: Sets the part of speech of one existing stem analysis after checking the expected current value. Its inflection class, if any, must belong to the new part of speech; Motif stages a Draft for a person to review and Apply.
compose-set-stem-part-of-speech.source: Hand-written from the closed intent and composer contract.

fields.target: Id of the stem analysis whose part of speech changes.
fields.expectedPartOfSpeech: Id of the part of speech the stem analysis has now, or null when it has none.
fields.partOfSpeech: Id of the part of speech to set.

goals: Give a stem analysis a part of speech
Fix the part of speech of one stem
Fill in a missing part of speech
compose-set-stem-part-of-speech.redirect: Changes one stem's category, and with it which slots its affixes may fill. Check the evidence that the stem belongs to that category first (guide suffix-prefix-slots).

compose-edit-affix-inflection-classes.title: Edit affix class restrictions
compose-edit-affix-inflection-classes.description: Replaces an ordinary inflectional prefix, suffix or interfix's exact class restriction set after checking the expected current ids. An empty set removes the restriction; for derivational affixes, use compose-edit-derivational-affix-restriction instead. Motif stages a Draft for a person to review and Apply.
compose-edit-affix-inflection-classes.source: Hand-written from the closed intent and composer contract.

fields.target: Id of the ordinary inflectional prefix, suffix or interfix form to edit.
fields.expectedInflectionClasses: Ids of the inflection classes the form is restricted to now, as an unordered set; empty when it has no restriction.
fields.inflectionClasses: Ids of the inflection classes the form should be restricted to, as an unordered set; empty removes the restriction.

goals: Restrict an affix to certain noun classes
Remove the class restriction from a suffix
Change which classes a prefix attaches to
compose-edit-affix-inflection-classes.redirect: For inflectional affixes only. Use compose-edit-derivational-affix-restriction for derivational affixes; use a feature for agreement (guide feature-conditioned-slots).

compose-edit-derivational-affix-restrict.title: Restrict a derivational affix
compose-edit-derivational-affix-restrict.description: Sets, replaces or explicitly clears the From Inflection Class and can set the exact From Exception Features on an existing affix entry's derivational grammatical info. Omitted fields stay unchanged. Motif stages a Draft for a person to review and Apply.
compose-edit-derivational-affix-restrict.source: Authored from the typed command contract.

fields.msa: Id of the derivational grammatical info of an existing affix entry.
fields.fromInflectionClass: Optional id of an inflection class owned by the From category or an ancestor; omission leaves the current link unchanged.
fields.clearFromInflectionClass: Set true to remove the current From Inflection Class; do not combine with fromInflectionClass.
fields.fromExceptionFeatures: Optional exact set of valid From Exception Features; an empty list removes them all, and omission leaves the current set unchanged.

goals: Restrict a derivational affix to stems of one inflection class
Set the From Exception Features on a derivational affix
Stop a derivational affix applying to unmarked stems
compose-edit-derivational-affix-restrict.redirect: For a derivational affix only. An inflectional affix is restricted by the inflection classes on its form (compose-edit-affix-inflection-classes).

compose-edit-allomorph-condition.title: Edit an allomorph condition
compose-edit-allomorph-condition.description: Changes the environment references on one existing stem or affix allomorph after checking its current list. Shared environments remain unchanged for every other allomorph that uses them. Only a person can Apply.
goals: Change where an allomorph is allowed to appear
Add an environment to a stem variant
Change which position an affix form takes
compose-edit-allomorph-condition.redirect: Keep variants of one morpheme under one entry with narrow conditions. Not for a regular sound change across forms: use a phonological rule (guide nasal-assimilation).

compose-edit-natural-class.title: Edit a natural class
compose-edit-natural-class.description: Adds or removes phonemes from one existing segment natural class after checking its exact current members. The response lists rules, environments and insertions that still use the class. Only a person can Apply.
goals: Add a vowel to an existing class
Remove a sound that does not belong in a class
Correct the members of a natural class
compose-edit-natural-class.redirect: Keep sound classes narrow: list only the sounds the pattern needs, never a class spanning unrelated sounds (guide nasal-assimilation).

compose-relink-natural-class.title: Relink natural-class users
compose-relink-natural-class.description: Moves explicitly named environments and rewrite-rule contexts to a replacement class created earlier in the Draft. Other users remain on the source class. Only a person can Apply.
goals: Replace a class with a corrected one everywhere it is used
Move environments and rules onto a new vowel class
compose-relink-natural-class.redirect: Keep sound classes narrow: list only the sounds the pattern needs, never a class spanning unrelated sounds (guide nasal-assimilation).

find-composer.title: Find a composer
find-composer.description: Finds the composing commands that fit a goal in a linguist's words, or lists every composer that serves a Subject. Each result gives its title, when to use it, its Subjects and its intent schema; detailed adds a worked example and the Subject's page. Reads only; nothing is staged.

compose-batch.title: Compose many intents
compose-batch.description: Stages every intent in a JSON file in one Draft with one project load, through the same checks as each composing command alone. If any intent is refused, nothing is added, and both a label and a Rationale are still required before Finalize. Only a person can Apply.
compose-batch.redirect: Prefer the specific typed composer; batch only stages several in one Draft. One small Proposal per grammar question (guide workflow).

compose.title: Compose steps in a Draft
compose.description: Stages one or more composing steps in a Draft in one call, each a composing command's name and closed intent, and can first remove earlier operations. A later step sees the earlier ones, and if any step or removal is refused, nothing changes. Only a person can Apply.
compose.redirect: Prefer the specific typed composer; batch only stages several in one Draft. One small Proposal per grammar question (guide workflow).

compose-author-text.title: Author a text
compose-author-text.description: Stages a new Text from a title and paragraphs of segments of word tokens in a Draft, creating a wordform for each token that has none. A token reuses a wordform only when its exact NFD form already exists in the writing system. Only a person can Apply.
compose-author-text.source: Authored from the typed command contract.
goals: Enter a short text to analyse
Add an interlinear text paragraph by paragraph
Create a text from segments of words

compose-edit-analysis-decision.title: Decide an analysis
compose-edit-analysis-decision.description: Stages one human decision about an existing analysis or wordform in a Draft: approve, disapprove, return to unknown, mark the spelling incorrect, or store a parser reading as an unknown analysis. It names the exact canonical identity. Only a person can Apply.
compose-edit-analysis-decision.source: Authored from the typed command contract.
goals: Approve an analysis of a word
Disapprove a wrong analysis
Return a wordform to undecided
Approve the analysis in an interlinear text
compose-edit-analysis-decision.redirect: Records a decision about an analysis. If the evidence does not decide, ask the linguist instead of guessing (guide ask-the-linguist).

order-allomorphs.title: Order alternate forms
order-allomorphs.description: Changes the order of existing alternate forms within one entry after checking their current order. The lexeme form cannot be moved, and Motif stages the moves in a Draft for human review. Only a person can Apply.
goals: Put the most specific alternate form first
Reorder the alternate forms of an entry
order-allomorphs.redirect: Keep variants of one morpheme under one entry with narrow conditions. Not for a regular sound change across forms: use a phonological rule (guide nasal-assimilation).

compose-author-feature-structure.title: Author grammatical features
compose-author-feature-structure.description: Stages an empty feature structure on an existing or earlier-staged stem or inflectional affix MSA in a Draft, refusing an occupied slot even when its structure has no selections. Inflectional affix features are word requirements; use the returned exact structure identity to author selections. Only a person can Apply.
compose-author-feature-structure.source: Authored from the typed command contract.
goals: Attach grammatical features to a stem
Say which features an inflectional affix carries
compose-author-feature-structure.redirect: Restrict a slot's affix by feature value; do not copy affixes or slots per value. Arbitrary lexical grouping is an inflection class (guide feature-conditioned-slots).

compose-author-affix-process.title: Author an affix process
compose-author-affix-process.description: Stages a new affix entry whose ordered input pattern matches phonemes, a natural class or the remaining stem, and whose output copies named parts or inserts phonemes: an infix, a partial or full reduplication, or a substitution that deletes matched input by omitting it from the output (Cebuano paN- before p/b gives m). It refuses an output that copies nothing or drops the remaining stem. Dry Run and Trial before a person Applies the Proposal.
compose-author-affix-process.source: Authored from the typed command contract.

fields.morphType: Id of an affix morph type such as prefix, suffix or infix.
fields.analysisWs: Analysis writing system tag for the gloss and definition.
fields.form: Optional headword shown for the entry, in the vernacular writing system formWs, without the hyphens FieldWorks shows on affixes (for example in for the infix -in-). Give it with formWs.
fields.formWs: Vernacular writing system tag for form.
fields.msa: Affix grammatical info: kind inflectional, derivational or unclassified, its category, and for derivational toCategory, for inflectional slots.
fields.input: Ordered pattern parts, each with a name and one of phoneme, naturalClass or remaining true; the remaining-stem part is last.
fields.output: Ordered realization, each item either copy of a named input part or insert of phoneme ids. An input part left out of the output is deleted.

goals: Add an infix that is inserted after the first consonant of a stem
Copy the first syllable of a stem to mark a meaning
Repeat a whole stem with a separator between the copies
compose-author-affix-process.redirect: Use for infixes, reduplication and stem-internal changes. Another pattern-based form of an existing entry: compose-author-affix-process-allomorph. Regular nasal assimilation is a phonological rule (guide nasal-assimilation).

compose-author-feature-value.title: Author a feature value
compose-author-feature-value.description: Stages a closed feature specification in an existing or earlier-staged structure, with value omitted when unchosen. Inflectional affix requirements use current morphosyntactic definitions, and any supplied value must belong to the exact feature. Only a person can Apply.
compose-author-feature-value.source: Authored from the typed command contract.
goals: Mark a noun as plural in its feature structure
Set a value for a feature on an affix
Leave a feature unspecified on a stem
compose-author-feature-value.redirect: Restrict a slot's affix by feature value; do not copy affixes or slots per value. Arbitrary lexical grouping is an inflection class (guide feature-conditioned-slots).

compose-author-phoneme.title: Author a phoneme
compose-author-phoneme.description: Stages a phoneme with explicitly authored name and representations in a Draft. Use its created identity in later natural classes or phonological rules. Only a person can Apply.
compose-author-phoneme.source: Authored from the typed command contract.
goals: Add a missing consonant to the sound inventory
Record a vowel with its written representations
Add a phoneme that rules will refer to
compose-author-phoneme.redirect: Add a phoneme for a real contrast, not only to record a surface variant, unless a rule needs it as an output segment (guides nasal-assimilation, conditioned-allomorphs).

compose-edit-phoneme.title: Edit a phoneme's representations
compose-edit-phoneme.description: Stages new written representations for an existing phoneme, or respells one it has, so a multigraph such as ng, ts or dy is another way the same segment is written and never a second phoneme. It refuses a spelling another phoneme or boundary already has, and a respelling that an environment writes. Dry Run and Trial before a person Applies the Proposal.
compose-edit-phoneme.source: Authored from the typed command contract.

fields.add: New representations to append, each an object with a representation, such as ng.
fields.respell: Current representations to replace in place, each with from and to.

goals: Add the digraph ng as a way to write an existing nasal phoneme
Write the affricate with the digraph ts
Respell a phoneme's representation without creating a second phoneme
compose-edit-phoneme.redirect: Edit a phoneme for a real contrast, not only to record a surface variant, unless a rule needs it as an output segment (guides nasal-assimilation, conditioned-allomorphs).

compose-author-natural-class.title: Author a natural class
compose-author-natural-class.description: Stages a named segment natural class with explicitly declared phoneme members in a Draft. Members may name existing phonemes or phonemes created earlier through declared dependencies. Only a person can Apply.
compose-author-natural-class.source: Authored from the typed command contract.
goals: Make a vowel class for harmony rules
Group the voiceless stops into one class
Define a class of sounds that an environment can name
compose-author-natural-class.redirect: Keep sound classes narrow: list only the sounds the pattern needs, never a class spanning unrelated sounds (guide nasal-assimilation).

compose-author-environment.title: Author an environment
compose-author-environment.description: Stages an environment with explicitly declared left and right contexts in a Draft. Contexts use project phonemes, natural classes or boundaries. Only a person can Apply.
compose-author-environment.source: Authored from the typed command contract.
goals: Say that a form appears after a vowel
Describe the sounds before and after where an affix changes
Make a word-initial environment for a rule
compose-author-environment.redirect: Keep the environment as narrow as the evidence. For a regular change across many forms use a phonological rule, not environments (guide nasal-assimilation).

show.title: Show a Proposal
show.description: Reads one saved Proposal or Draft by id, with its status, label, Rationale, note and operations. It does not change the FieldWorks project.
show.source: Authored from the typed command contract.

parsimony --dry-run.title: Parsimony dry run
parsimony --dry-run.description: Queues a comparison of one measure before and after the Proposal behind a completed Dry Run job, on a private copy of the project. It does not change the FieldWorks project.
parsimony --dry-run.source: Authored from the typed command contract.

parsimony --dry-run --wait.title: Parsimony dry run wait
parsimony --dry-run --wait.description: Queues the before and after comparison for a completed Dry Run job and waits for its two stored Reports. It does not change the FieldWorks project.
parsimony --dry-run --wait.source: Authored from the typed command contract.

trial.title: Trial a Proposal
trial.description: Measures a Draft or finalized Proposal on a throwaway copy, producing a Dry Run and Assessments. Read negatives now parsing, positives lost, unfinished cases, other changes and counts before revising.
trial.source: Authored from ADR 0058 and the typed command contract.

trial --wait.title: Read Trial progress
trial --wait.description: Waits for a Trial job and reads its state. Read the stored Difference after the Trial completes.
trial --wait.source: Authored from ADR 0058 and the typed command contract.

motif_grammar.title: Read grammar
motif_grammar.description: Reads the Baseline grammar by kind and exact object identity. Choose a kind to page through its objects, or omit it for counts.
motif_grammar.source: Authored from the agent read contract.

motif_lexicon.title: Read lexicon
motif_lexicon.description: Searches Baseline entries and counts them by morph type and category. Filter by morphType, affix, category, headword or hasGloss. Concise results are one line per entry with its sense ids; detailed results include senses, allomorphs and their environments.
motif_lexicon.source: Authored from the agent read contract.

grammar read.title: Read grammar objects
grammar read.description: Reads phonemes, natural classes, environments, parts of speech, inflection features or lexical entries from the current Baseline. Use an exact canonical id or a name query, and page through larger lists.
grammar read.source: Authored from the typed grammar read contract.

difference produce.title: Compare a Trial with decisions
difference produce.description: Compares a completed Trial's parses with the approved, disapproved and misspelled decisions FieldWorks records for one Text, and saves the result. It reads stored evidence, runs no parser and never blocks an Apply.
difference produce.source: Authored from the Proposal Difference contract.

difference show.title: Read a saved comparison
difference show.description: Reads a saved comparison of a Trial with FieldWorks' recorded decisions: totals, a before and after table and a page of changed words. Filter to words that could be bad, to one category, or to one approval state.
difference show.source: Authored from the Proposal Difference contract.

motif_activity.title: Read agent activity
motif_activity.description: Reads calls, Proposals and jobs from this conversation and the selected project.
motif_activity.source: Authored from the agent read contract.

motif_guide.title: Read encoding guidance
motif_guide.description: Reads an encoding guide or the draft, Dry Run, Trial, revise and Finalize workflow.
motif_guide.source: Authored from the agent read contract.

motif_list_projects.title: List Known projects
motif_list_projects.description: Lists the Known projects a person has added to this installation. Select one by name or its recorded path for project tools.
motif_list_projects.source: Authored from the agent read contract.

motif_difference.title: Read Trial Difference
motif_difference.description: Pages through a stored Trial Difference by category. Unfinished parser cases are separate from words that no longer parse.
motif_difference.source: Authored from the agent read contract.

new.title: Start a Proposal
new.description: Starts a named Draft holding one related set of semantic changes. Set a short label and a Rationale before Finalize, then measure and revise the Draft. Only a person can Apply.
new.source: Authored from ADR 0058 and the typed command contract.
new.redirect: Start one small Proposal per grammar question, then try it before anything else (guide workflow).

finalize.title: Finalize a Proposal
finalize.description: Finalizes a Draft as an immutable Proposal revision for a person to review. The Draft needs both a short label and a Rationale. Evidence for unchanged content on the same Baseline remains current.
finalize.source: Authored from ADR 0058 and the typed command contract.

dry-run.title: Dry Run a Proposal
dry-run.description: Queues a Dry Run of a Draft or finalized Proposal on a throwaway copy of its Baseline. Its effects are bound to that content and project state.
dry-run.source: The shared command catalog and typed request contract.

dry-run --wait.title: Read a Dry Run
dry-run --wait.description: Waits for the Dry Run of a Draft or finalized Proposal and reads its effects. Content and Baseline identify whether the evidence remains current.
dry-run --wait.source: Authored from ADR 0058 and the typed command contract.

remove-operations.title: Remove Draft operations
remove-operations.description: Removes explicit operations from a Draft while respecting declared dependencies. Revise and measure the content again before Finalize. Only a person can Apply.
remove-operations.source: Authored from ADR 0058 and the typed command contract.

add-set-gloss.title: Set a sense gloss
add-set-gloss.description: Stages the explicitly authored gloss of one sense in one writing system in a Draft. Dry Run and Trial the Draft before Finalize; only a person can Apply.
add-set-gloss.source: The shared command catalog and typed request contract.

compose-author-lexeme-form.title: Author a lexeme form
compose-author-lexeme-form.description: Stages a lexeme form with explicitly authored spelling, writing system and morph type in a Draft. Dry Run and Trial the Draft before Finalize; only a person can Apply.
compose-author-lexeme-form.source: The shared command catalog and typed request contract.
goals: Set the lexeme form of an entry
Add the citation form of a new stem or affix
Record the lexeme form in another writing system
Fix the headword spelling of an entry
compose-author-lexeme-form.redirect: Keep variants of one morpheme under one entry with narrow conditions. Not for a regular sound change across forms: use a phonological rule (guide nasal-assimilation).

list.title: List Proposals
list.description: Lists open Proposals and Drafts, including each identity, label and status. Add --all to include closed ones, or --status to list one status.
list.source: The shared command catalog and typed request contract.

proposals.title: List Proposals
proposals.description: Lists every Proposal with what it changes and the numbers its latest Trial measured beside today's. Proposals are grouped by what to do next; applied and set-aside ones are counted unless asked for.

delete --proposal.title: Delete a closed Proposal
delete --proposal.description: Deletes a declined, superseded or withdrawn Proposal that never applied, with its Trials. An applied Proposal is never deleted.

proposal review.title: Review a Proposal's changes
proposal review.description: Lists every change in one Proposal in the order to read them: grammar changes first, then word changes. Each entry says whether it has been looked at, and the list carries the Proposal's latest Trial.

apply --proposal.title: Apply one Proposal
apply --proposal.description: Applies one Proposal to the FieldWorks project as one unit of work, using the result of its latest Trial. MCP never applies; the CLI applies in person or in Autonomous mode. It has no Readiness override of its own.

label.title: Label a Draft
label.description: Sets or replaces the short label that identifies a Draft in lists and review. The label does not change its operations, and only a person can Apply the Proposal.

proposal rationale.title: Write a Proposal's Rationale
proposal rationale.description: Writes or replaces what a Proposal changes and why, in Markdown. The Rationale stays outside the Proposal's content, so rewriting it never changes what the Proposal does, and it can be rewritten until the Proposal is applied or closed.

proposal note.title: Write your note on a Proposal
proposal note.description: Writes or clears the person's own note on a Proposal, in Markdown. Only a person writes it; an assistant can read it beside the Rationale.

reject --proposal.title: Decline a Proposal
reject --proposal.description: Declines a Proposal you do not want. It is kept with its Trials as history, and you can reopen it later.

reopen --proposal.title: Reopen a Proposal
reopen --proposal.description: Opens a declined or withdrawn Proposal again as a Draft under the same id, with its history kept. An applied or superseded Proposal is never reopened.

withdraw.title: Withdraw a Proposal
withdraw.description: Takes back an open Proposal and keeps its history. A person can reopen it later as a Draft.

compose-author-inflection-feature.title: Author inflection feature
compose-author-inflection-feature.description: Adds a closed morphosyntactic feature and its named values to a Draft. Use the created ids in feature-structure and stem-name authoring, then Dry Run and Trial the Draft before Finalize.
compose-author-inflection-feature.source: Hand-written from the closed intent and composer contract.
goals: Add a number feature with singular and plural
Define a tense feature with its values
Create a feature that agreement can refer to
compose-author-inflection-feature.redirect: Restrict a slot's affix by feature value; do not copy affixes or slots per value. Arbitrary lexical grouping is an inflection class (guide feature-conditioned-slots).

compose-author-inflection-class.title: Author inflection class
compose-author-inflection-class.description: Adds an inflection class or subclass, such as a noun class, to a Draft. Its owner is explicit and the category's default is unchanged; use the created id when authoring a stem.
compose-author-inflection-class.source: Hand-written from the closed intent and composer contract.
goals: Add a noun class
Define a gender or agreement class that nouns are assigned to
Create a subclass of an inflection class
Add a verb conjugation class
compose-author-inflection-class.redirect: Use only when stems arbitrarily pattern differently for the same affix. A value that must agree is a feature, not a class (guide feature-conditioned-slots).

compose-author-stem-name.title: Author a stem name
compose-author-stem-name.description: Adds a category-owned stem name with explicit feature regions to a Draft. Each region states where an allomorph bearing this stem name is eligible; attaching it to an allomorph is a separate operation.
compose-author-stem-name.source: Hand-written from the closed intent and composer contract.
goals: Name the stem shape used in the plural
Say where a special stem form is allowed
Add a stem name for a set of feature conditions
